parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is the toggle or actuator part of the switch, made of durable plastic. It is small and rectangular, designed to be pressed or flipped by the user.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the user interface for turning the electrical circuit on or off by changing its position.
parts.Movement_description: It moves linearly or pivots slightly when pressed or flipped, enabling or disabling the electrical connection.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main housing or base body of the switch, made of insulating plastic. It encloses the internal electrical contacts and supports the actuator.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and electrical insulation for the internal components, ensuring safe operation.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move during operation, serving as the fixed part of the switch assembly.
